notes.title: September 24, 2025 Game Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609591/a2ffd596e0ade4256ffd56fb8770c2827e77fc5c.png"][/img][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]Added Biryu Field Bosses[/p][p][i](General Angul is scheduled for next week as previously announced)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Boss:[/b] Angul Shogun has been introduced and will now spawn at random locations in Biryu. [i]Defeating him offers a high chance to obtain rare [b]Forbidden Weapons and Equipment[/b][/i][/p][/*][/list][h2]Feature Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Portal cost to Biryu reduced from [b]500,000[/b] to [b]120,000[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Increased the level of Biryu monsters, boosting their Prana rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Biryu monsters now provide [b]50% more Prana[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced stats for all craftable Biryu accessories, including the [b]Ring of Rama[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Ring of Rama[/b] now displays a name corresponding to each tribe[/p][/*][*][p]The following items have been added to the item mall:[/p][list][*][p]PvP Event Ticket[/p][/*][*][p]Quality Ziva Pustika ([i]this item is sold per unit[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Itara[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The maximum stack size of Jewel of Life has increased from [b]40[/b] to [b]100[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Simplified buff countdown timer text by removing unnecessary parentheses and the word [i]left[/i][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Corrected the Spanish localization for the attribute that increases all resistances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Buka Jama’s buff timer, which previously displayed 5 minutes instead of the correct 10 minutes[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where trading or storing Rupiah was incorrectly processed as a Sacrificial Pot offering[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed duplicate buff icons appearing when different classes applied buffs with the same effect[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected an issue where a lower-level Mantra Skin could override a higher-level one[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Server Selection screen displaying earlier than intended[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Biryu Update is Now Live!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609591/4d41ecb5ea67fac434c0a107e5eabe651cfd6f58.png"][/img][/p][p]The wait is finally over, and we’re so sorry for the long delay! We needed extra time to make sure everything works properly and that the Biryu systems can’t be abused. But now, the update is live and ready for all adventurers level 80 and above, with the [b]maximum level cap set at 95[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]For those who are unfamiliar with Biryu, this update is packed with exciting features. Soon, you’ll be able to try your luck with the [b]Yut Nori[/b] gambling game, craft powerful new [b]Datu weapons and accessories[/b] and join epic battles in [b]Castle Siege[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Some features are currently unavailable, but don’t worry, they’ll be released step by step as we continue to fine-tune and protect them from exploits. So get ready, prepare your character, and stay sharp for when these features come online![/p][p][/p][h1]September 18th, 2025 Update Notice[/h1][p][/p][h3]Event[/h3][p]All existing accounts will receive an untradable 7-day Tikoy Pack and an Event Pranas Orb of LaNena (+50%), courtesy of LaNena.[/p][p][/p][h3]Map Release & Patch Notes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Biryu map is now open[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Requiores Lv. 80. Maximum level is now 95[/p][/*][*][p]The portal to [b]Town of Biryu[/b] is now accessible from the [b]Way to Coliseum[/b] in [b]Mandara[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]New Features[/h3][p][b]Merchant Oda — Accessory Upgrade System[/b] The accessory upgrade system has been reworked. [b]Itara[/b] has been added as an upgrade material[/p][list][*][p]Itara can be crafted using Biryu materials plus Rupiah[/p][/*][*][p]Itara is required to upgrade to higher-tier accessories[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrading with Itara now has a chance of success[/p][/*][/list][h3]General Changes[/h3][list][*][p]H.Q. Blue Pranas Orb is now added to the Item Mall, providing +150% Prana Boost for 4 hours[/p][/*][*][p]Quest “A Strange Eastern Country” final reward increased from 1 to 20 Ziva Pustika[/p][/*][*][p]A quest that required [b]Yut Nori[/b] play has been temporarily modified to use an alternate requirement; the original requirement will be restored in a future update[/p][/*][*][p]Removed level prefixes from the names of Adigo, Manthao, and Gato[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing NPC dialogue text across all supported languages[/p][/*][/list][h3]Temporarily Unavailable Features[/h3][p]The following features will be added step by step as we keep improving them. So don’t slack off. Make sure you’re ready, or you might get caught unprepared when these features roll out! [/p][list][*][p]Yut Nori event[/p][/*][*][p]Consignment Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Ashram storage[/p][/*][*][p]Mudha portal[/p][/*][*][p]Merchant Yuri[/p][/*][*][p]Biryu bosses[/p][/*][*][p]Castle Siege[/p][/*][*][p]Castle Siege info command[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][b]Developer notes[/b] Yeah, we know these features bring life to Biryu, and we want to assure you that everything, including Yut Nori, is working as expected. However, we’re carefully reviewing each feature to prevent any chance of player abuse. Some systems, like the Consignment Shop, are being completely reworked so that no one ends up being banned due to some abuse. Our goal is to make Biryu a place full of excitement where everyone can enjoy the game fair and square![/p][/quote]

notes.title: September 12, 2025 Game Update
notes.content: [h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]Added tooltip descriptions for applied buffs and debuffs in the buff bar[/p][/*][*][p]Added a countdown timer for applied buffs and debuffs in the tooltip description[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented various safety interaction measures around the Refinement Altar, Sacrificial Pot, and NPCs[/p][/*][/list][h2]General Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Pisaci Preta now drops Artificial Tooth regardless of level.,[/p][/*][*][p]Removed redundant confirmation dialogs when selling or buying items from NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Vidya’s TP Mastery reduced from 10 to 9[/p][/*][*][p]Localized the union chat command and added language-specific aliases:[/p][list][*][p][b]Korean:[/b] /연, /연합[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chinese:[/b] /联, /联合[/p][/*][*][p][b]English & Japanese:[/b] /union, /alliance[/p][/*][*][p][b]Indonesian:[/b] /persatuan, /aliansi[/p][/*][*][p][b]Portuguese:[/b] /união, /aliança[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spanish:[/b] /unión, /alianza[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the self-target key appeared in different locations on keyboards from other regions. It now remains to the left of the 1 key regardless of keyboard layout[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where purchasing stacked items from vendors displayed quantity and price in reverse in the in-game system log[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the level requirement notification for using Ziva Pustika to teleport was not localized; it is now fully localized for all supported languages[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where too many .dmp files were being generated unexpectedly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rejecting a quest prevented the character from re-accepting it[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where requesting Samudaba to a dead character locked the player’s movement[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Biryu Update Notice
notes.content:
[h1][b]Important Announcement Regarding the Biryu Update[/b][/h1][p][/p][p align="start"]Hello everyone,[/p][p align="start"]We have an important update regarding the release schedule for the upcoming Biryu Update.[/p][p align="start"]After careful consideration, we have made the decision to [b]postpone the release from its originally scheduled date of September 9th to September 16th.[/b][/p][p align="start"]This additional week is crucial to allow our team to conduct thorough final testing and quality assurance. Our priority is to deliver a stable, polished, and enjoyable experience for all players, and this short delay is necessary to meet the high standards we set for ourselves and that you expect from us.[/p][p align="start"]We want to assure you that this extra time will be dedicated to extensive testing to identify and resolve any potential issues. We are committed to ensuring the new content is balanced and performs smoothly across all platforms.[/p][p align="start"]We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding. We are incredibly excited for you to experience everything the Biryu Update has to offer, and we believe this short wait will be well worth it.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p align="start"]The release is now scheduled for:
[b]🗓️ New Date: Monday, September 16[/b][/p]

notes.title: August 23, 2025 Game Update
notes.content: [h2]Feature Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Increased Pranas earned in Shambala Dungeon by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Added important information, tips, and tricks to the Recharge Taney options in the Premium Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Removed level indicators from K[b]ruma guards[/b] and [b]Door names[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The Premium Menu can no longer be opened while a Personal Shop is active[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the contextual menu (right-click options) from the window title bar in Window Mode[/p][/*][*][p][b]DirectX 9[/b] is now fully integrated into the client, bringing enhanced visual effects and minor performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Improved client security, preventing critical external modifications[/p][/*][*][p]Improved client stability and overall FPS performance[/p][/*][*][p]Removed "Unshaped" options from Goods Salesman Rui Shan[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where summons didn’t work against Emperor's Tomb Library monsters[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash where players would disconnect after 1 hour while standing in a Personal Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Datu Canes incorrectly increased damage by 20% instead of 10%[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug where Charm of Darani II showed a percentage-based defense increase when refined (visual only)[/p][/*][*][p]The game executable is no longer flagged as a false positive by antivirus software. Please note that the launcher may still trigger false positives, but it will soon be deprecated as all settings are being moved directly into the game client[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Union chat button failed to send messages to the Ashram Union[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sending PMs to [b]Union[/b] did not reach the Ashram Union chat[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some laptops with hybrid GPUs defaulted to integrated graphics instead of the dedicated GPU[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a runtime error issue that could crash the client[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Shambala Prana Event
notes.content: [h3]For 24 hours, Shambala will have x2 Pranas![/h3][p]Ends on August 18, 2025 +8 GMT[/p]

notes.title: August 15, 2025 Game Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Feature Changes[/b],[/h2][list][*][p]Increased the width of the Ashram window to fit more text without forcing line breaks.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added 7-day versions of the existing 30-day consumable services to the Item Mall.,[/p][/*][*][p][b]High Fabric[/b] now has a 14% drop rate from [b]Ugra Ulkamukha[/b], [b]Ugra Ulkamukha Caura[/b], and [b]Ugra Ulkamukha Satvan[/b]. 
[b]This material will not drop if your character is 20 levels or more above the monster.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The game client now opens directly to the server selection screen, skipping the initial zoom animation.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b],[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where BGM volume reset upon changing maps and then lowered again.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash issue where the client would unexpectedly close after using Alt+Tab.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing characters from attacking other players in Kruma.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where entering Vendor Mode caused players to be disconnected after 10–15 minutes.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect Anubaba effects and descriptions for Azukata.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Recharge Taney[/b] button failed to open the Steam Overlay; a notification will now alert players when this occurs.,[/p][/*][*][p]Applied additional fixes to translations and descriptions across all supported languages.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the client to freeze or close when changing maps.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the client failed to launch after loading EasyAntiCheat.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the client froze after clicking [b]OK[/b] on the server selection screen.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game client was not detected by the GPU on certain laptops.[/p][/*][/list][h1]Kathana Wiki[/h1][p][url="https://kathana.gitbook.io/"]https://kathana.gitbook.io/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Kathana Early Access
notes.content: [h1]Kathana is coming to Steam for everyone![/h1][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45609591/d54d3c0443247bec2ce637511fbdcabc45003689.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]This Friday, August 8 (-3 UTC)[/b], we’re officially opening Kathana’s Early Access on Steam, no Steam keys required. Just search for “Kathana” on Steam and join the fight.[/p][p][/p][p]From that moment on, all Taney purchases will be made directly from inside the game via Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Add Kathana to your wishlist to get notified the moment the gates open.[/p][p][/p][p]Get ready for a new era... [b]The world of Kathana awaits.[/b][/p]
